_comment: Version-controlled crawler policy (SEO/GEO spec CRAWLER-001). robots.txt is GENERATED from this file by build/robots.mjs - never hand-edit robots.txt. Policy owner: GATMEDI. Decided 2026-08-31 by the owner: search/retrieval AND training crawlers are all allowed on public routes (D1: do not block GPTBot/ClaudeBot). Revisit before major releases.
_disallow_note: Crawl hygiene only, NOT security: these are the application surfaces, kept out of crawl budgets. The real indexation control is the X-Robots-Tag: noindex header the platform sends on these paths, and the real access control is authentication. Never list a path here as a substitute for either.
